selection: first checkpoint with 100 consecutive complete training episodes averaging >=0.5; final checkpoint if unsolved, explicitly labelled
evaluation: 30 independent Unity process seeds per frozen model; no exploration or learning; no tuning on these results
truncation: report separately, break rolling window; no aggregate evaluation mean if any evaluation episode truncates
aggregation: mean and population SD of three model evaluation means, not confidence interval or significance
legacy_done_limit: local_done treated as terminal; internal timeout cannot be distinguished by this API
